Loss report: forgejo -> drone

[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build job.runner (only the platform has a Drone form; other runner labels are lost)

[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.if (a step condition cannot guard an action that is not a step: the action is not written as a step)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.script (no command of the step has a Drone spelling; the step is not written)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.shell (Drone compiles commands into its own set -e script that runs under /bin/sh; a step with no shell from a GHA or GitLab source runs under bash there, so bash-only syntax fails when the image sh is dash)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-2 step.shell (Drone compiles commands into its own set -e script that runs under /bin/sh; a step with no shell from a GHA or GitLab source runs under bash there, so bash-only syntax fails when the image sh is dash)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-2 step.if: shell guard on the first script line (the condition has no Drone filter; the step shows success instead of skipped)
